_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
O kile wa Bapadi {player_id} mo papading ya Bapadi ba {num_players} ya Liar's Dice.
Melao:
- Ka nako ya gago, o ka:
  1) Fetola kgahlano e mpsha ka bontši bja bontle bja kgahlano ya bjale, goba bontši bja kgahlano ya bjale (goba bobedi); e.g. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Bita kgahlano ya mafelelo ka go ngwala '[Call]'.

Ge o bita:
  - Ge palo ya nnete ya boleng bjoo bja sefahlego hara dike gotee le kgahlano, mofetolela wa kgahlano ya mafelelo o lahlegetšwe ke die e tee.
  - Gaešita, mobiti o lahlegetšwe ke die e tee.
Mopadi yo a fago 0 dike o hlakantšhwa. Mopadi wa mafelelo a setseng o thopa.

board.new_round:
Mafelo a mantsi - Diketo tse di shalilwego: {dice_summary}
Diketo tsa gago tse di shalilwego kwa moja kwa moja ke: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Morabaraba {current_player_id} o bitsa! Palo ya 'nete ya sefahlego {face_value} ke {count}, e bile NYANE go {quantity}.
Morabaraba {loser_id} (mofeti wa mafelelo) o lahlehetše tšebe e tee.
call.caller_loses:
Mmopi {current_player_id} a bitsa! Palo ya diketo tse nang le mofuta {face_value} ke {count}, e le >= {quantity}.
Mmopi {loser_id} (yo bitsang) a shala die moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Go be go se na thekišo e dirilwego pele.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Tefelo ya go se be le mohola: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kgato e sa tsebjeng e le kgato e kgolo '[Bid: X, Y]' goba '[Call]'. Kgato e isitsweng: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Palo ye mpsha {new_quantity} ke ya ka tlase ga yeo e lego gona bjale {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Tlhomo e ntswa ya mofuta {new_face_value} e le tlase ya ya kgale {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Thekišo e swana le thekišo ya gona bjale.
bid_reason.face_range: Boleng bja go bonala bo swanetše go ba magareng ga 1 le 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Sebapadi {player_id} se ile sa rakwa ka baka la mosepelo wo o sego wa loka.
